description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Procurement-relevant Federal Register documents: FAR rulemaking, acquisition policy notices, and Procurement List (AbilityOne) actions. Filter by keyword; returns title, type, agencies, publication date, and abstract with a link to the full document. Abstracts only, read the full document before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
